newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algeria rejects Turk plan to set up Iraq zone.
newsitem.headline: Algeria rejects Turk plan to set up Iraq zone.

text.p: Algeria on Sunday joined Arab nations lambasting Turkey's plan to establish a security buffer zone in northen Iraq against Kurds fighting from there for autonomy in southeast Turkey.

Algeria said the Turkish security bid infringed international law. "It undermines Iraq's sovereignty and territorial unity," said Algeria's foreign ministry spokesman in a statement read on the Algerian radio.
Turkey said last week it was planning to set up a security zone to ward off Turkish Kurdish rebels who use northern Iraq as a launching pad for attacks in southeast Turkey.
